single_factor_theorem: If the minimal polynomial is Phi_{p^r}, then pI=(I-M)Q(M) for an integral polynomial Q; hence p annihilates coker(I-M). If its order is p^n, it is (Z/p)^n.
multi_factor_bound: s distinct p-power cyclotomic factors imply cokernel exponent divides p^s
Leech_d9: Phi3*Phi9 gives exponent dividing 9; the measured Smith form has exponent 9 and saturates the bound
correction: Pure single-factor support => elementary quotient is a theorem. The converse for arbitrary mixed integral modules is not implied by characteristic-polynomial support alone.
claim_boundary: The quotient-field statement is arithmetic; a descended nondegenerate alternating form remains an additional theorem.
